const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "const targets=[",
  "  ['zhihu_home','https://www.zhihu.com/'],",
  "  ['zhihu_api','https://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/articles/2058636429199160879'],",
  "  ['zhihu_zhuanlan_noCookie','https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2058636429199160879']",
  "];",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=targets.length) return;",
  "  const t=targets[i++]; const u=t[1];",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  await sleep(i===1?1000:12000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html,application/json','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      const b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      console.log(t[0]+' -> '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length+' head='+b.substring(0,80).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-zhtest.cjs", content: js });
